title: Presidential Candidates Have Busy Schedule This Tuesday (8)
subtitle: Interviews, meetings with supporters, and technical visits mark the candidates' day.
excerpt: This Tuesday (8), presidential candidates have a packed schedule including a questioning session, interviews, meetings with leaders, and technical visits across the country.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The presidential candidates' schedule this Tuesday (8) includes interviews, meetings with supporters, and technical visits across the country. There is also participation in a questioning session and meetings with local leaders.

Renan Santos (Missão)At 8 AM, he participates in a questioning session at Jovem Pan, in São Paulo (SP). At 9:30 AM, he gives an interview to Paulo Mathi.

With information from Agência Brasil.
